blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Agnes Callamard, a former United Nations special rapporteur whom former President Rodrigo Duterte banned in the Philippines to keep her from investigating the drug war killings, has returned to the country to reignite the calls for justice after seeing that victims still live in fear and that “too little has changed.” Now the secretary-general of Amnesty International, Callamard on Friday led the launch of “Walang Pahimakas” (No Farewell), an anthology of poems on the drug war. This is her first public appearance since the Bureau of Immigration (BI) lifted her eight-year ban on entering the country. “So far […]...
